faixaIds: 900001–900999 são do Poke Fable (o maior id do dump é 190036, data/ItemConfig.json com 4339 itens)

900001.d: Raises a Pokémon by one full level. Only works from level 1 to 15.

900002.d: Raises a Pokémon by one full level. Only works from level 16 to 25.

900003.d: Raises a Pokémon by one full level. Only works from level 26 to 40.

900004.d: Raises a Pokémon by one full level. Only works from level 41 to 50.

900005.d: Raises a Pokémon by one full level. Only works from level 51 to 75.

900006.d: Raises a Pokémon by one full level. Only works from level 76 to 100.

900010.d: Held by a parent at the Day Care, it can pass that parent's nature on to the egg. From the paid pass track; bound to your account.
900010.origem: passe T1 (trilha paga) + lab-ovo; a natureza passa COM CHANCE, nunca 100 % (Jaime, 27/09); o valor é da lab-ovo, a aprovar

900011.d: The level 45 outfit from the Season 1 paid track. Bound to your account; comes back at launch, in the Vault.
900011.origem: passe T1 (não existe no dump: a Amanda desenha a roupa)

900020.d: 10 common pieces and ₽1,000 make a common TM at the TM counter in the Celadon Department Store (2F). Dropped by wild Pokémon, trainers and missions. Bound to your account; the finished TM can be traded.

900021.d: 6 strong pieces, 20 common pieces and ₽5,000 make a strong TM at the TM counter in the Celadon Department Store (2F). Dropped by Gym Leaders, rematches, shiny Pokémon, high-level areas and the Elite Four. Bound to your account.

900022.d: 3 rare pieces, 6 strong pieces and ₽20,000 make a rare TM at the TM counter in the Celadon Department Store (2F). Only dropped by raids, the Elite Four crowning and collector titles (up to 4 a week). Bound to your account.

900030.d: Earned by playing: the 1st from the Route 5 Day Care mission, the 2nd when your first egg hatches. Place it on your plot: it hatches an egg in 6 h. Bound to your account.
900030.origem: Jaime 01/10 (modelo próprio); lab-ovo; beta 89: o texto do data/ovo.json, no Terreno

900040.d: Your reward for fighting the guild boss (1 to 5 a day). Never expires. Trade them for items at the guild shop. Bound to your account.

900070.d: A reward from Articuno raids. Collect 20 in your Bag to call Articuno to your team (Lv 50). Bound to your account: it can't be traded or sold.
900070.origem: lab-raids (01/10): fragmento próprio; o do dump (110144) fica fora

900071.d: A reward from Zapdos raids. Collect 20 in your Bag to call Zapdos to your team (Lv 50). Bound to your account: it can't be traded or sold.
900071.origem: lab-raids (01/10): fragmento próprio; o do dump (110145) fica fora

900072.d: A reward from Moltres raids. Collect 20 in your Bag to call Moltres to your team (Lv 50). Bound to your account: it can't be traded or sold.
900072.origem: lab-raids (01/10): fragmento próprio; o do dump (110146) fica fora

900073.d: A reward from Mewtwo raids. Collect 20 in your Bag to call Mewtwo to your team (Lv 70). Bound to your account: it can't be traded or sold.

900080.d: Team Pokémon that don't battle get part of the battler's XP: 1% to 50%, the most when their level reaches 2/3 of the battler's; the share is split between them. Bound to your account.
900080.origem: bal-expshare-2 + bal-expshare-quem (Jaime 01/10 noite): a conta é o xpDosTreinados da lab-balanceamento; a missão que dá o item é da lab-questline (2ª insígnia)

900150.d: Cuts 3 hours off the hatching of an egg in an incubator. Once per egg. Sold in the Diamond Shop. Bound to your account.
900150.origem: lab-ovo (data/ovo.json → itens); ovo-incubadora-2 (1 por ovo) e ovo-incubadora-3 (preso); beta 89: t 3 no lugar do 9 (a Mochila trata o 9 como remédio); 20 Diamantes, de qualquer Diamante (o preço é da loja)

900151.d: The same incubator, sold in the Diamond Shop. Place as many as fit on your plot: each one hatches an egg in 6 h. Tradeable: it can go on the Market.
900151.origem: lab-ovo (data/ovo.json → itens); ovo-incubadora-3 (negociável, sem teto); beta 89: Diamante é Diamante (Jaime 11/10) — de qualquer Diamante, sai solta; o preço é A APROVAR (a loja de Diamantes)

900170.d: 30 days of +20% XP for your Pokémon, +100 Box slots, +10 Market listings, −50% Travel and Teleport cooldown and the chat badge. The time adds to what you already have, up to 365 days. Use it or sell it on the Market for Coins.
900170.origem: beta 88 (plano 88, F1): ec-reprecificar (200 Diamantes, de qualquer Diamante: Diamante é Diamante, 11/10), ec-trava (negociável), medalhao-beneficios; os números da J2 (data/medalhao.json, 10/10); t 5 e q 5 A APROVAR

900171.d: 60 days of +20% XP for your Pokémon, +100 Box slots, +10 Market listings, −50% Travel and Teleport cooldown and the chat badge. The time adds to what you already have, up to 365 days. Use it or sell it on the Market for Coins.
900171.origem: 27/10 (o Kronyx: "O certo é comprar de 30, 60 e 90 dias"): o Medalhão de 60 dias, um item só (antes, a loja entregava 2 de 30 dias); a mesma regra do de 30
